modes.standalone: Exact-source READY public master browser checks.
modes.mounted: Actual source-bound compiler output and EN/BG320/390/1440 journeys at both variant-2 and variant-3.
modes.dealer: Requires final individualized build and public alias verification.

checks.name: catalog-completeness
checks.scope: Exact committed catalogs have complete EN/BG key and interpolation parity; actual public rendering is covered separately. This is not a claim of perfect translations for arbitrary future dealer data.

checks.name: hardcoded-ui
checks.scope: Fresh locale route audits check visible text and language leaks, plus exact selected native source/copy tests. New source is not excused as styles-only; September behavior evidence is not relabelled.

checks.name: native-routing
checks.scope: Fresh native policy tests and public redirect, resource/admin boundary, locale navigation and deep-link checks.

checks.name: standalone-journeys
checks.scope: Fresh selected-source standalone master public journeys in EN/BG at 320/390/1440. Local mounted compilation is separate evidence.

checks.name: mounted-journeys
checks.scope: Fresh actual source-bound Modern production compilation and mounted browser journeys in both slot orders, EN/BG at320/390/1440. Dealer hosted acceptance remains separate.

checks.name: public-journeys
checks.scope: Fresh anonymous exact-source READY master public browser journeys. Dealer hosted acceptance still required after the package is deployed.

checks.name: preferences-no-js
checks.scope: Fresh EN/BG actual native preference form fallback with JavaScript disabled.

checks.name: preferences-storage-disabled
checks.scope: Fresh denied storage and conflicting/rejected cookie preference behavior, retaining actual localized rendering.

checks.name: preferences-races
checks.scope: Fresh slow-save cancellation, dismissal, stale response and hostile return URL preference behavior with actual pages; harness mock responses are disclosed.

checks.name: request-isolation
checks.scope: Fresh explicit locale versus hints/cookies and alternating requests, cache isolation and immutable native policy tests.

checks.name: security-write-blocking
checks.scope: Fresh public HTTP denial of invalid/guard-probe business writes and malformed/cross-origin preference requests; no real enquiry is submitted.

checks.name: assets-preserved
checks.scope: Every retained source asset Git blob/mode matches the exact public READY mirror, and fresh browser journeys check observable images/resource paths.

approvedTemplate.reason: Reviewed immutable Cars template source; dealer adoption is explicit.
